text: 近日，有市场消息称，部分省份中小银行收到监管提示，要求金融投资增速不得高于贷款增速、新增债券久期不得高于存量久期。 对此，知情人士在记者求证时表示，金融管理部门并未就中小银行金融投资增速和新增债券久期作出全国统一安排。在市场化原则下，中小银行基于自身资产负债状况进行的债券投资决策，属于其自主经营权范畴。
text_en: Recently, market news claimed that small and medium-sized banks in some provinces received regulatory reminders requiring that the growth rate of financial investment must not exceed the growth rate of loans, and the duration of newly added bonds must not exceed the duration of existing holdings. In response, when asked for verification by reporters, people familiar with the matter said that financial management authorities have not made a nationwide unified arrangement regarding the growth rate of financial investment and the duration of newly added bonds for small and medium-sized banks. Under market-based principles, bond investment decisions made by small and medium-sized banks based on their own asset-liability conditions fall within the scope of their independent operating rights.
